name: py-build-from-approved-plan
prompt: /sdlc-build for changes/2026-10-claim-notes. Follow plan.md step by step; run make test and make lint at the end.
allowed_tools: Read,Write,Edit,Grep,Glob,Task,Bash(make test),Bash(make lint),Bash(make format),Bash(git add:*),Bash(git commit:*),Bash(git status),Bash(git diff:*),Bash(.sdlc/bin/sdlc:*)

checks.run: uv run python -c 'from claims.app import App; a=App(); a.handle("POST","/claims",b"{\"policy_number\":\"P\",\"amount_cents\":5}"); s,n=a.handle("POST","/claims/1/notes",b"{\"author\":\"Ana\",\"text\":\"called\"}"); assert s==201, (s,n); assert a.handle("GET","/claims/1")[1]["notes"][0]["text"]=="called"; assert a.handle("POST","/claims/1/notes",("{\"author\":\"A\",\"text\":\"" + "x"*501 + "\"}").encode())[0]==400'
